description: Checks a 17-character vehicle identification number (VIN): validates its check digit, decodes make, model and model year with NHTSA's vPIC service (only the first 11 characters are sent, or 14 for low-volume manufacturers; never the serial number), then lists the NHTSA safety recall campaigns issued for that make, model and year, with the same fields as vehicle_recalls. It does not confirm whether this specific vehicle is included in a campaign or has been repaired; NHTSA's own VIN lookup at nhtsa.gov/recalls is the official source for that.

detail.description: "brief" (default) keeps each result short; "full" adds the complete text fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (1-50, default 10).

vin.description: 17-character VIN, e.g. "1HGCV1F37JA000001". Spaces and dashes are ignored; letters I, O and Q never occur in VINs.

name: vin_recalls
title: Vehicle recalls by VIN
